notes: Fully passive DI box — "no power required" per manufacturer specs, so there is no power connector to list. Front/rear panel also carries five switches that are NOT physical connectors and were excluded from the ports list per the schema: a -15dB input pad, a MERGE switch (turns Input+Thru into a passive mixer to sum stereo to mono), a 180° polarity-reverse switch, a Ground Lift switch, and a Parallel Speaker switch (adds a -30dB band-pass pad emulating a 12" guitar speaker for reamping via Thru). Confirmed against three Radial-authored sources: the product page (radialeng.com/product/jdi), the Specifications tab (radialeng.com/product/jdi/specifications/), and the official Smart Sheet PDF (radialeng.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/12/Radial-SmartSheetBook-JDI.pdf), which includes a labeled connector/switch diagram — all three agree. Dimensions 5" x 3.3" x 1.8" (127 x 84.1 x 45.5mm), weight 1.55 lbs — a small desktop/stage-floor unit, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. No connector on this device belongs to a bandwidth-graded family (HDMI/SDI/DP/USB/RJ45), so no "grade" fields apply. Type "Converter" was chosen as the closest fit in the given enum (the JDI converts high-Z unbalanced instrument level to balanced mic level via transformer) — no dedicated "DI box" type exists in the schema.

ports.name: Input
ports.note: Unbalanced 1/4" instrument input; closest connector id is ts-6.35 (TS, not TRS).

ports.name: Thru
ports.note: Unbalanced 1/4" pass-through feeding the instrument amp; also used as the second leg of the Merge (stereo-to-mono) function.
